## The claim

P4-21: among Bub1b mouse genotypes, a hypomorphic or compound hypomorph genotype matches the child best, so the interventions tested in hypomorph mice are the ones to import

**Prediction if true.** the top-scoring Bub1b genotype carries a hypomorphic allele (e.g. H/H or H/L1002P), not a null or heterozygous knockout

**What would refute it.** a null, knockout or heterozygous-null Bub1b genotype scores highest
